context:
Core subsystem tests (intellicrack.core.* orchestration, session, tools registry, config, elevation, disassembler, script/xml generation). Context:

- Drive the REAL core object end-to-end (Orchestrator, ToolRegistry, session, TemplateManager, ScriptGenerator) and assert the concrete produced effect against an independent oracle: recompute the expected dispatch target, parse the generated script/XML and assert exact structure/values, or check the registry maps a tool name to the real bound method. Never assert isinstance/not-None/that-a-method-was-called.

- The disassembler wraps capstone: the INDEPENDENT ORACLE is capstone itself driven a different way (or hand-assembled known instruction bytes whose mnemonic/operands you assert). Disassemble real bytes and assert the exact mnemonic/op_str, not len>0.

- Elevation/UAC is the ONLY permitted double (it is an external OS prompt) - stub it at that boundary and assert the real downstream command/effect. A test that genuinely needs admin/elevation legitimately SKIPS when not elevated - keep those skips.

- Script/XML generators: parse the produced artifact (ElementTree / ast / json) and assert exact nodes/attributes/values against an independently constructed expectation.
